items.author: Musk
items.text: Exclusive: Musk tells Isaacson "AI and robots" will need to fix deficit
items.summary_cn: 据媒体称，Musk向Isaacson表示人工智能和机器人将成为解决美国财政赤字的重要力量，凸显其对AI与机器人长期潜力的看好。

items.author: 洪灏
items.text: 洪灝：市場恐慌性拋售已近尾聲，年底前大機率迎來大反彈
items.summary_cn: 据媒体转述，洪灏认为市场恐慌性抛售已接近尾声，并判断年底前大概率出现大幅反弹，对港股风险偏好偏乐观。

We will destroy the Little Satan and the Big Satan.” What Country can survive when things such as this are allowed to be said, because eventually, they always end up being true? items.author: Burry
items.text: Michael Burry Warns Stock Market Could Be Months Away From A 2000-Style Reckoning — ‘The Preconditions Seem Set For Fireworks’
items.summary_cn: 据媒体报道，Michael Burry警告美国股市可能经历类似2000年的剧烈清算，当前市场状况已具备相关风险条件。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX thrusters just made a Tesla Roadster 'fly' (and Elon Musk's car is still out there in space)
items.summary_cn: 媒体称SpaceX推进器可将特斯拉Roadster送入太空，该演示继续强化Musk旗下航天与电动车技术协同的市场想象。

items.author: Musk
items.text: TikTok “Permanently Suspends” the ‘Musk’ Film Ad Account Before Reinstating It, Raising Suppression Fears (Exclusive)
items.summary_cn: 媒体称TikTok曾永久停后又恢复一个名称涉及Musk的广告账户，引发对平台审查的担忧，但缺乏明确财务影响。
